name: GCloud Cloud Run Actuator
description: Union actor for bounded, real Cloud Run discovery, deployment, and invocation through gcloud.

skills.name: Discover Cloud Run service
skills.description: Reads an exact Cloud Run service descriptor.

skills.name: Deploy Cloud Run service
skills.description: Deploys one exact service/image/region tuple; bearer authority required.

skills.name: Invoke Cloud Run service
skills.description: Invokes one exact Cloud Run service URL; bearer authority required.
